title: Patch: Legendary (animated) and Mythic (signed) full-art tiers, and fifteen more iconic cards join the full-art club
notes: Every full-art card now has three full arts: the Epic still face, a Legendary that moves (the art drifts and a light sweeps over it) and a Mythic that also signs the card's English name across the art (R2655000, R2655003). The Legendary and Mythic are chases, granted to no account, earned from a duplicate's roll, a cosmetic pack or the Chase Shard bar; no token buys them. The cosmetics registry is now the list of full-art cards (R2655001): fifteen more cards of every type join the six portrait cards, and the tokens of five of them wear their parent's full art (R2655002). A card's full-art pick chooses off, Epic, Legendary or Mythic among the tiers owned, checked by the server and frozen into a match's loadout; migration 0072 keeps the pick's id. Reduced motion and Animated foil off hold every tier still. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Animated and signed full arts, and fifteen more full-art cards
new: Every full-art card has two new chase versions: an animated Legendary full art, and a Mythic one that also signs the card's name. Earn them from duplicates, cosmetic packs and the Chase Shard bar.
Fifteen more cards print full art, among them League of Losers, Bread and Butter, The Mother Pancake and In Too Deep, each in a still, an animated and a signed version.
Some of those cards' tokens print full art with them.
changes: A card's cosmetics in the Collection now let you pick which full art it wears: none, or any version you own.
